requirements.criterion: Four internal beats are 350/600/600/1250ms, boundaries 0/350/950/1550/2800ms, with CAPTURED and DETECTING mapped to IMAGE_RECOGNIZING.
Every advance requires its minimum beat and corresponding real pipeline event; timer-only success is impossible.
Inference beyond 2800ms stays in a quiet low-intensity CLASSIFYING hold until real result and business gates.
An early real result does not shorten the minimum optical story.
Peripheral water reaches zero during 2600–2800ms inside CLASSIFYING; no additional RESOLVE state or pre-navigation wait exists.
Photo, SWOS, BBox and trusted subject geometry share EXIF-normalized RecognitionImageTransform/photoContentRect; effects do not leak into FIT letterbox.
Real-photo result reads as irregular layered sunlight/water behavior, not legacy seven-path tracing, HUD, scanner, closed neon border or full-frame tint.
Trusted contour only follows trust-gated real subject geometry; BBox-only fallback is regional glow and never a traced rectangle.
Same photo/session/transform and residual gold source continue into RR09; RR09 T0 is first actually presented Result frame.
Reduce Motion retains state/result/actions with a static optical composition; CTA remains independent of motion completion.
No model threshold, confidence semantics, route, business data, frozen photo or static Result layout changes.
